audit_findings.title: Post-acquisition interest and economics are absent from the historical OE claim
audit_findings.magnitude: $1.2 billion purchase consideration and approximately $1.2 billion bridge loan; recurring net OE effect unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: Bridge-loan interest and recurring integration costs reduce equity-level OE, while eliminated Pizza Hut license fees increase OE; the post-close balance sheet also replaces the pre-close bridge inputs.
audit_findings.evidence: Interest expense is recognized over the term of the borrowing and recorded in the Consolidated Statements of Income.
audit_findings.explanation: This is a demonstrated perimeter and timing error. The acquisition closed before the valuation date, but the capitalized OE and balance-sheet bridge are entirely pre-close. The transaction and financing each equal about 10.6% of the $11.298 billion base equity value, so the unmodeled recurring economics are reasonably capable of changing the valuation conclusion. Direction is mixed because interest and integration costs work against license-fee savings.
audit_findings.action: Build a post-close pro forma using the bridge-loan rate and fees, expected refinancing terms, transaction and integration costs, tax effects, and filed Pizza Hut license-fee savings; replace the June 2026 balance sheet and rerun all scenarios.

audit_findings.title: Parent-share numerator may be contaminated by consolidated NCI cash-flow adjustments
audit_findings.magnitude: FY2024 NCI income $69 million, equal to 10.2% of the $678.3 million anchor; FY2024 ordinary and redeemable NCI claims totaled $699 million, equal to 6.2% of the $11.298 billion base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: Using parent-attributable earnings with consolidated D&A, capital spending, working-capital movements or other adjustments misallocates owner earnings between parent shares and noncontrolling interests.
audit_findings.evidence: We maintain a controlling interest of 58 %, 70 %, 83 %, 92 % and approximately 60 % in the entities that own and operate the KFCs in and around Shanghai, Beijing, Wuxi, Suzhou and Hangzhou, respectively.
audit_findings.explanation: The record demonstrates a basis mismatch, although it does not establish the exact annual OE error. The NCI scale is large relative to both the anchor and base equity value, so a coherent allocation could materially change parent-share value. Direction remains mixed because consolidated add-backs can overstate parent OE while consolidated reinvestment deductions can understate it.
audit_findings.action: Rebuild every OE year on one consistent basis: either parent-attributable cash flows throughout or consolidated cash flows followed by explicit deductions for ordinary and redeemable NCI shares of D&A, capital spending, working capital and other adjustments; then rerun the trend anchor.

audit_findings.title: The valuation omits the most recent completed fiscal year
audit_findings.magnitude: one full fiscal year omitted; FY2025 filed operating profit $1.290 billion, parent net income $929 million, operating cash flow $1.466 billion, D&A $448 million and capital spending $626 million; judged FY2025 OE unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: The missing FY2025 observation affects normalized OE, the log-trend anchor, growth evidence and the too-hard assessment.
audit_findings.evidence: In addition, past financial performance may not be a reliable indicator of future performance and historical trends should not be used to anticipate results or trends in future periods.
audit_findings.explanation: This is a demonstrated error because the supplied FY2025 10-K contains the completed-year financial statements, yet the OE series stops at 2024. The omitted year contains results large enough relative to the $678.3 million anchor to require judgment under the same OE rails. Its valuation direction cannot be established until the year is normalized consistently, including NCI allocation.
audit_findings.action: Calculate and document FY2025 OE from the filed statements using the existing methodology, reconcile every adjustment, extend the series through 2025, and rerun the anchor, scenarios and too-hard determination.

audit_findings.title: Cash and short-term investments may not be distributable excess cash
audit_findings.magnitude: unquantified; the bridge adds $1.386 billion, equal to 12.3% of base equity value or approximately $3.96 per diluted share
audit_findings.mechanism: Any restricted, pledged, operationally required or leakage-exposed portion must be excluded from the cash bridge rather than added dollar-for-dollar to common equity.
audit_findings.evidence: Furthermore, cash transfers from the Company’s PRC subsidiaries to its subsidiaries outside of China are subject to PRC government control of currency conversion.
audit_findings.explanation: This is an unresolved possibility, not a demonstrated $1.386 billion error. The filing shows actual transfer capacity, including $1.023 billion of dividends from Hong Kong subsidiaries to the Delaware parent in 2025, but it does not trace the June 2026 cash and short-term investments by entity or identify the operating-cash requirement. Because the added pool is 12.3% of base equity value, the unresolved eligible portion could be material.
audit_findings.action: Obtain the June or post-close treasury schedule by entity and jurisdiction; reconcile it to the filed balances and exclude restricted, pledged and minimum operating cash plus any unprovided withholding, conversion or repatriation leakage before rerunning the bridge.

audit_findings.title: The active transfer-pricing audit could create an unmodeled senior tax claim
audit_findings.mechanism: An assessment, interest and penalties would reduce equity through a direct bridge deduction and could also reduce normalized OE if the ruling changes recurring tax or franchise-payment treatment.
audit_findings.evidence: However, if the STA prevails in the assessment of additional tax due based on its ruling, the assessed tax, interest and penalties, if any, could have a material adverse impact on our financial position, results of operations and cash flows.
audit_findings.explanation: The active audit is demonstrated, but no adverse assessment or estimable exposure is established. The company states that significant developments are reasonably possible and that an adverse outcome could be material, while also stating that the amount cannot presently be estimated. The record therefore cannot establish whether the claim is large enough to change the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Obtain post-June-2026 developments, the tax advisers' probability and loss range, and any proposed assessment or settlement terms; deduct a probability-weighted amount or run explicit tax-liability scenarios once supportable.

audit_findings.title: The separation tax indemnity is an unquantified claim ahead of common equity
audit_findings.magnitude: unquantified; potential tax rate is 10% of the difference between the separated China business's fair value and its minimal tax basis, with Yum China's share determined by the contractual market-capitalization allocation
audit_findings.mechanism: Any payment owed to YUM under the indemnity is a senior contingent liability requiring a direct deduction from the equity bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: Such a settlement could be significant and have a material adverse effect on our results of operations and our financial condition.
audit_findings.explanation: The indemnity and potentially significant liability are demonstrated, but the record does not show a tax-authority challenge, a probable payment or an estimable amount. The filed 10-Q continues to classify the contingent payment as not probable or estimable. It may affect value, but present evidence cannot establish materiality to the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Confirm whether authorities have initiated a challenge, obtain the separation-date taxable base and contractual allocation calculation, and secure a current legal or tax-adviser probability range; model a bridge deduction or explicit downside scenario if the exposure remains live.
